text:
maya: Quick heads up — we need a very small, urgent patch for the runtime mem leak hitting some Dedicated customers. Planning to bump 1.3.7 -> 1.3.8 and ship today if we can keep diffs minimal. Who can own cut + smoke?

alex: I can cut the tag if we have a checklist. do we have a known minimal PR list?

maya: minimal: revert of https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4826 (the change that regressed the allocator), plus a tiny metrics guard. i'll post PR numbers in a sec. this should be < 4 files.

jc: We should freeze the release branch while we cherry-pick. Suggest: create release/1.3.x-hotpatch, cherry-pick, run smoke, tag. Sam/dex if you can stand by for quick rollback.

sam: available for smoke. what infra tests do we need? quick perf, memory checks, and healthchecks. i'll run them once alex cuts.

olivia: i'll open the changelog entry. super small: one-line "fix: avoid allocator growth causing OOM on long-running inference" and reference customer issue and PR.

maya: PRs: #4892 (revert), #4898 (metrics guard). total diff ~ 120 LOC. changelog draft: "1.3.8 (patch) — fix allocator growth in runtime; improved memory guards; backported to dedicated clusters."

alex: checklist for cut: 
```
# local
git fetch origin
git checkout -b release/1.3.x-hotpatch origin/release/1.3.x
git cherry-pick <pr-4892-commit>
git cherry-pick <pr-4898-commit>
# run unit + smoke
# push and create tag
```
I'll push branch and open a PR for CI. planning to tag after green CI.

release-bot: CI status: release/1.3.x-hotpatch build queued (expected ~18m).

jc: Add a note to Redwood Console to route a small % of traffic to hotpatch in Dedicated if we want canary. But if it's customer-impacting, maybe full rollout after validated.

maya: agree. plan: canary 5% for 30m after smoke, then 100% if metrics stable. sam will watch memory/cpu. alex do you want the tag name 1.3.8 or 1.3.8-hotpatch? we should keep semver clean -> 1.3.8.

alex: ok tagging as v1.3.8. i'll post the actual tag when done.

olivia: changelog entry ready, will add PR link and customer issue id.

sam: once tag posted i'll kick perf/memory scripts and post results here.

maya: thanks. timeline: aim to cut by +30m (1887650181). if CI flakes, we fall back to manual test runs but try not to delay. ping me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:

alex: tagging now — v1.3.8 pushed. release-bot should announce.

release-bot: Tag created: v1.3.8 on release/1.3.x-hotpatch by alex. Release notes draft: minimal patch for allocator leak.

sam: smoke started — live perf + mem snapshots running. will post pass/fail in ~10m.

olivia: changelog PR linked: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4905 (waiting for alex to merge branch).

maya: perfect. after canary window we'll merge to mainline if all good and bump any package pins. Great work, team.

sam: smoke green. mem graphs stable, no OOMs observed. :tada:

jc: rolling to 100% for Dedicated clusters now per canary policy. I'll update rollout docs after.

alex: merging hotpatch branch to release and closing PRs. will follow up with deploy notes.

maya: closing loop: customer notified, internal postmortem scheduled for tomorrow to prevent recurrence. thanks everyone. :heart:
__notes: Thread content is a single continuous string with messages prefixed by sender name per agents.md rules. Includes code block and bot messages.
